info.name: SpotOn Reserve Availability Paid In Outs API

params.name: locationId
params.description: The unique identifier for the location.

params.name: createdAtStart
params.description: Inclusive RFC 3339 start of the creation range. Max 7-day range.

params.name: createdAtEnd
params.description: Exclusive RFC 3339 end of the creation range. Must be at least 5 minutes in the past.

items.docs: Retrieve all paid in/out records created within a specified date range for a location. A single date range cannot exceed 7 days.

params.name: locationId
params.description: The unique identifier for the location.

params.name: paidInOutId
params.description: The unique identifier for the paid in/out record.

items.docs: Retrieve a single paid in/out record by its unique identifier for a location.
